description: This file defines a Google Image Generation Provider module, including configuration, model normalization, image size mapping, and an async function to generate images via Google's API.

methods.name: normalizeGoogleImageModel
methods.description: Normalizes the Google image model string, trimming and defaulting if undefined.

methods.name: mapSizeToImageConfig
methods.description: Maps a size string to an image configuration object with aspect ratio and resolution.

methods.name: buildGoogleImageGenerationProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ImageGenerationProvider object configured for Google.
